title: Long Term Safety Study in Patients With HLH/MAS in Still's Disease Exposed to Gamifant.
off: Long-term Safety of Gamifant® in Adult and Pediatric Patients With HLH/MAS in Still's Disease With Inadequate Response or Intolerance to Glucocorticoids, or With Recurrent MAS

officials.n: Andrew Ramsey, MD MPH. Study physician

summary: This study aims to evaluate safety information in patients with HLH/MAS in Still's disease exposed to Gamifant.
desc: This is a prospective, low intervention, multicenter safety study to evaluate and characterize the long-term safety of Gamifant, an approved treatment for patients with HLH/MAS in known or suspected Still's disease. Pediatric and adult patients with HLH/MAS in known or suspected Still's disease, including sJIA, with inadequate response or intolerance to glucocorticoids, or with recurrent MAS, and who have either initiated Gamifant within the past 0 to 7 days or are prescribed to initiate Gamifant in accordance with the approved product label, are eligible for inclusion in the study.
elig:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Has received at least 1 dose of Gamifant 0-7 days prior to ICF date or is prescribed to initiate Gamifant.
* Aged ≤80 years at index Gamifant administration.
* Diagnosis of secondary HLH/MAS according to the treating physician.
* Diagnosis or suspicion of Still's disease (sJIA or AOSD) according to the treating physician.
* Patients who have shown inadequate response or intolerance to high-dose glucocorticoids or who have recurrent MAS, according to the treating physician. Recurrent MAS is defined as any MAS episode that has occurred after resolution of the first-ever MAS episode.
* Patient agrees to provide relevant specimen (blood, sputum, and/or urine samples) for laboratory testing as outlined in the study protocol.
* Informed consent must be obtained from the patient or the patient's legally authorized representative.

  * For minors capable of providing assent (as determined by local regulations and the Investigator's judgment), informed assent must be obtained in accordance with applicable local regulations. If a minor is unable to provide assent due to age, developmental stage, or medical condition, the reason will be documented.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of pHLH or sHLH consequent to proven metabolic, malignancy, or a rheumatic disease other than Still's disease at index date.
* Clinically active Mycobacterium tuberculosis (typical and atypical), Histoplasma capsulatum, or Salmonella infections at the index date based on investigator's assessment.
* Evidence of leishmania infections at the index date based on investigator's assessment.
* Concurrent participation in an interventional clinical trial.
* Severe, uncontrolled concurrent illness at the index date likely to confound outcome assessment with expected survival \<28 days based on investigator's assessment.
* Pregnant at the time of study entry

arms.l: HLH/MAS in Still's disease treated with Gamifant
arms.d: Patients aged ≤80 years at index Gamifant administration who have received at least 1 dose of Gamifant 0-7 days prior to ICF date or is prescribed to initiate Gamifant for the treatment of HLH/MAS in Still's disease

primary.m: Outcome Measure: Incidence rate of treatment-emergent mycobacterium tuberculosis

x.titre: Sécurité à long terme de l'émapalumab (Gamifant) dans le SAM/LHH de la maladie de Still
x.question: Quelle est l'incidence des infections graves ou opportunistes sous émapalumab chez les patients ayant un SAM/LHH au cours d'une maladie de Still ?
x.contexte:
Le syndrome d'activation macrophagique (SAM), forme de lymphohistiocytose hémophagocytaire secondaire (LHH), est une complication grave de la maladie de Still (AJI systémique, maladie de Still de l'adulte). Il associe fièvre, cytopénies, hyperferritinémie et défaillances d'organes, avec une mortalité non négligeable.

L'émapalumab (Gamifant) est un anticorps anti-interféron gamma, approuvé pour le SAM de la maladie de Still, connue ou suspectée, en réponse inadéquate ou intolérance aux corticoïdes, ou en cas de SAM récidivant. Le blocage de l'interféron gamma expose en théorie à un risque d'infections, notamment mycobactériennes, à Histoplasma, à Salmonella et à CMV.

Cette étude prospective multicentrique de sécurité du fabricant (Sobi) suit environ 70 patients, enfants et adultes jusqu'à 80 ans, dans le cadre de l'autorisation de mise sur le marché.
x.interet: Elle précisera le profil de risque infectieux à long terme de l'émapalumab, utile pour surveiller les patients traités.
x.profil: Des enfants et adultes (≤ 80 ans) avec un SAM/LHH au cours d'une maladie de Still, traités ou sur le point d'être traités par émapalumab.
inclusion: Au moins une dose de Gamifant dans les 0 à 7 jours avant le consentement, ou prescription prévue
LHH/SAM secondaire selon le médecin traitant
Maladie de Still (AJIs ou maladie de Still de l'adulte) connue ou suspectée
Réponse inadéquate ou intolérance aux corticoïdes à forte dose, ou SAM récidivant
Prélèvements biologiques acceptés, consentement (assentiment pour les mineurs)
exclusion: LHH primitive ou secondaire à une maladie métabolique, un cancer ou une autre maladie rhumatismale
Tuberculose, mycobactériose atypique, histoplasmose ou salmonellose active
Maladie sévère non contrôlée avec survie attendue < 28 jours
